items.a: Testing agents are AI agents that do QA work: writing test cases, running suites, repairing broken steps and explaining failures.

items.q: Which testing agents does TestMu AI offer?
items.a: KaneAI for authoring, HyperExecute for execution, Auto Healing for locator repair, root cause analysis for debugging, plus Agent Testing and Agent Assurance for AI agents.

items.q: Do the agents change what counts as a pass?
items.a: No. Healing changes how an element is reached. Pass or fail is checked against the criteria you wrote.

items.q: Can the agents work with my existing Selenium or Playwright tests?
items.a: Yes. HyperExecute runs existing suites, and Auto Healing and RCA work on those runs.
